# Contributing

Keep changes small and reviewable. Run all scripts in `tests` before opening a
pull request. Never commit generated state, logs, local configuration, account
identifiers, machine-specific paths, or authentication material.

Changes that add network access, new account mutations, credential handling,
installation scope, or administrator requirements must include an explicit
security and privacy review.

The UI and public documentation use English. Preserve the read-only default:
usage refresh is automatic only after consent; login and account switching must
remain explicit user actions.
